title: Avatar start-to-frame latency has zero instrumentation — every number in the waterfall is reasoned, not measured
/avatar/start re-fetches the avatar's display identity from Anam on every session start instead of caching it
Three independent lookups in /avatar/start are awaited sequentially, one duplicating a query the caller already ran
A fixed, unconditional 150ms delay is added to every avatar session start with no early-exit
The AudioContext/video-element prewarm cannot start until after the full /avatar/start round trip completes
No prefetch/warm path exists for the session-start request — entire backend waterfall starts only after the click
No <link rel=preconnect> to the Anam origin the client SDK connects to
Backend/worker containers have no CPU or memory resource limits on the 2-vCPU host
